firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Hellllo!!! 
Sharing the public repository for my paper-track submission, "Structure over Scale: When Do Code-Navigation Tools Compensate for Smaller, Quantized Gemma 4 Agents?"

Repo: https://github.com/NoorTasfia/structure-over-scale-paper

It contains the agent loop, all three toolsets, every one of the 900 episode trajectories, and the analysis scripts, so every number in the paper can be reproduced.

Short version of the findings (5 Gemma 4 configurations × 3 toolsets × 60 SWE-bench Lite instances, one RTX 4070):
- Code-graph tools help every model size (+5.3 points pooled, p = 0.031).
- A repository map crosses over with scale: −20 points for the strongest model, +10 for the weakest.
- Q8 quantization of E2B is free; Q4 halves accuracy.
- The 12B model mostly fails because its thinking overruns the reply budget at the moment it must answer.

Writeup: https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/gemma-4-developer-agent-paper/writeups/structure-over-scale

Questions and feedback welcome!
